# scaling_escalation_policy (Data Source)

Looks up an escalation policy by name and exposes its id, so a routing policy rule can reference a policy created out-of-band without hardcoding the generated id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Reference an escalation policy created out-of-band by name, for use as a
# routing policy rule's escalation_policy_id.
data "scaling_escalation_policy" "critical" {
  name = "Critical"
}

output "critical_escalation_policy_id" {
  value = data.scaling_escalation_policy.critical.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the escalation policy to look up. Must be unique within the organization.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description, or null if unset.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the matched escalation policy.
- `org_id` (String) Organization that owns the policy.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 last-update timestamp.
